difficulty_reason: Notion documents a public OAuth flow and integration setup; listing and approval timing depends on current review requirements not established here.
effort: Create an integration in the developer portal, configure OAuth redirect URIs and capabilities, then test with a workspace before any public listing request.
prerequisites: Notion developer account and integration configuration.
A public HTTPS redirect URI for deployed OAuth callbacks; confirm development options in current docs.

steps.title: Create an integration
steps.instruction: Create an integration and choose the capabilities and workspace access it needs.

steps.title: Configure OAuth settings
steps.instruction: Set the redirect URI and use the documented authorization flow. Keep the client secret private.

steps.title: Test access
steps.instruction: Authorize a test workspace and confirm only the expected pages and capabilities are accessible.

steps.title: Check public distribution requirements
steps.instruction: Review current submission and listing requirements in Notion's integration portal before planning public distribution.

approval.review_needed: UNCERTAIN for a public listing; current listing review requirements and timing should be confirmed in the developer portal.
approval.triggers: Public distribution, integration capabilities, and listing may have additional requirements; not fully established from the cited authorization guide.

blockers.fix: Check that the callback in the authorization request matches the integration's configured redirect URI.
Confirm the user has shared the page with the integration and that the requested capabilities are sufficient.

scopes.name: Integration capabilities
scopes.why: Select only the access your integration needs; exact public review implications depend on current Notion policy.

redirect_rules: Use the configured redirect URI for the integration and confirm current exact-match and development URL rules in Notion's authorization documentation.
agent_handoff: An agent can read the authorization docs and prepare settings and test cases. A human must log in, create the integration, set credentials and workspace access, and submit any distribution review.
next_action: Create a private test integration and validate its requested capabilities and callback before exploring public listing.
